## 1. Club position history chart (`/club`)

### Route & component chain

| Layer | File |
|-------|------|
| Route | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\App.tsx` — `/club` → `TeamStats` |
| Page | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\team\TeamStats.tsx` |
| Section | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\team\blocks\ClubOverview.tsx` |
| Chart component | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\pages\team\blocks\ClubPositionHistoryChart.tsx` |
| Option builder | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\teamHistoryChart.ts` |
| Data transform | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\clubMatrixHistory.ts` |
| ECharts wrapper | `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\charts\EChart.tsx` |

### Chart library

**Apache ECharts** (`echarts`), mounted through the thin `EChart` React wrapper.

### Data hook & API

- Hook: `useClubMatrix()` in `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\hooks\useLeague.ts`
- Endpoint: `GET /league/get_club_matrix?club=…`
- Payload shape: `ClubMatrixPayload.matrix.{ seasons, rows }` where each `ClubMatrixRow` has `team_number` + `seasons: Record<season, ClubMatrixSeasonCell>`

`historyFromMatrixRow()` normalizes cells into `TeamHistory`:

```typescript
// Record<season, { league_name, final_position, league_level }>
```

### How seasons & positions are plotted

1. One series per Mannschaft (team number within club).
2. X-axis: sorted seasons (`compareSeasonString`).
3. Y-axis: encoded league position via `combinedPositionValue()` — `(league_level - 1) * 10 + final_position`, so rank 3 in Bayernliga (level 3) plots at y=23.
4. Y labels are league names (not raw numbers), at tick values 5, 15, 25…
5. Series color: `getClubTeamColor(team)` → Mannschaft 1 = `rainbowPastel[0]`, Mannschaft 2 = `[1]`, etc.

### Inverted Y-axis & dot labels

Implemented in `buildPositionHistoryChartOption()`:

```89:147:c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\teamHistoryChart.ts
    yAxis: {
      type: "value",
      inverse: true,
      // ...
    },
    series: seriesList.map((s) => {
      const positions = seasons.map((season) => s.history[season]?.final_position ?? null);
      const values = seasons.map((season) => {
        const row = s.history[season];
        return row ? combinedPositionValue(row) : null;
      });
      return {
        // ...
        symbol: "circle",
        symbolSize: 28,
        label: {
          show: true,
          position: "inside" as const,
          color: "#fff",
          fontWeight: 600,
          fontSize: 12,
          fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono, monospace",
          formatter: (params: { dataIndex?: number }) => {
            const idx = params.dataIndex ?? 0;
            const pos = positions[idx];
            return pos != null ? String(pos) : "";
          },
        },
      };
    }),
```

Pattern: large circles (`symbolSize: 28`) with **white mono labels inside** showing the raw `final_position` digit, while the plotted Y value is the league-encoded composite.

## 2. Tournament page `/turnier?player=…`

### Route & orchestration

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `frontend\src\pages\tournament\TournamentStats.tsx` | Page controller; reads `season`, `tournament`, `round`, `player` from query |
| `frontend\src\pages\tournament\TournamentFilterBar.tsx` | Filters including player search |
| `frontend\src\pages\tournament\blocks\TournamentPlayerOverview.tsx` | **Player-only overview** (`?player=` without season+tournament) |
| `frontend\src\pages\tournament\blocks\PlayerSection.tsx` | **In-event drill-down** (`?player=&season=&tournament=`) |
| `frontend\src\lib\tournamentEventLinks.ts` | `buildTournamentPlayerEventPath()` for row navigation |
| `frontend\src\lib\tournamentOverviewTables.ts` | Tabulator data for player results table |

### Three display modes (`TournamentStats.tsx`)

```typescript
const showEventDetail = hasSeason && hasTournament;
const showPlayerDetail = showEventDetail && !!player;      // season+tournament+player
const showPlayerOverview = !!player && !showEventDetail;   // player only ← your case
const showPodiumOverview = !player && !showEventDetail;
```

### Hooks & API endpoints

| Hook | Endpoint | When enabled |
|------|----------|--------------|
| `usePlayerTournamentResults(player, season, tournament)` | `/tournament/get_player_tournament_results` | `!!player && !(season && tournament)` |
| `usePlayerSectionForTournament(season, tournament, player)` | `/tournament/get_player_section` | all three set |
| `useTournamentPlayers(...)` | `/tournament/get_available_players` | event detail |
| `useTournamentSeasons/Names/Rounds` | list endpoints | filter bar |

Defined in `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\hooks\useTournament.ts`.

### Player tournament history data shape

`TournamentPlayerResultRow` (from `usePlayerTournamentResults`):

```typescript
{
  season: string;           // e.g. "23/24"
  tournament: string;       // full event name from data
  tournament_group?: string; // normalized group (BM M, NBM M, SBM M, …)
  position?: number | null;  // final placement (KO-adjusted on backend)
  average?: number | null;   // cumulative avg at end
  club?: string | null;
}
```

Backend builder (`app/services/tournament_service.py` → `get_player_tournament_results`):
- Derives `position` from last value of `position_series`, overridden by KO placement when present.
- Sets `tournament_group` via `normalize_tournament_group_name()`.
- Optional `season` / `tournament` query params filter results.

**Important:** `?player=` overview is currently a **table only** — no season-vs-position chart exists yet. Row click navigates to `?season=&tournament=&player=` via `buildTournamentPlayerEventPath()`.

### In-event charts (not cross-season history)

`PlayerSection.tsx` has two ECharts for a **single tournament**:
- Average progress per game (`buildAverageOption`)
- Rank progress per game (`buildPositionOption`) — also uses `inverse: true` on Y

Uses `TournamentProgressSeries` from `/tournament/get_player_section`:

```typescript
{
  labels?: string[];
  avg_series?: Array<number | null>;
  position_series?: Array<number | null>;
  game_score_series?: Array<number | null>;
  cut_lines_position?: Array<number | null>;
  cut_position_at_game?: Array<number | null>;
  participant_count?: number;
  // + field overlays from field_progress
}
```

## 3. Color scheme utilities (BM / NBM / SBM)

### Central file

`c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\color-utils.ts` — port of legacy ColorUtils.

### What exists today

| Utility | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `TEAM_COLOR_PALETTES.rainbowPastel` / `harmonic10` | 10-color series palettes (0-indexed) |
| `getPaletteColor(index)` | `palette[index % 10]` |
| `getSemanticColor("positive" \| "negative" \| …)` | semantic slots from palette |
| `TOURNAMENT_CUT_ROW_COLORS` | cut-row accents: `[2]` inside, `[3]` on cut, `[6]` outside |
| `HEATMAP_PALETTES` 1–6 | gradient stop pairs for score heatmaps (not wired to BM/NBM/SBM) |
| `getClubTeamColor()` | Mannschaft-number → palette index |

### Tournament type naming (not colors)

`c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\frontend\src\lib\tournamentGroupName.ts`:

```typescript
// Abbreviations from tournament_mapping.csv
"BM M", "BM D", "NBM M", "NBM D", "SBM M", "SBM D", …
normalizeTournamentGroupName(eventName)  // groups year variants
tournamentClusterKey(eventName)          // "t:<group>"
tournamentGroupAbbreviation(groupName)
```

### No BM/NBM/SBM “color 1 / color 2” mapping

There is **no** frontend constant mapping BM→color 1, NBM→color 2, SBM→color 3, etc.

“Color 1” in comments means **`rainbowPastel[0]`** (1-based naming), e.g. in `SeasonStats.tsx` and `TrendChart.tsx`.

Closest tournament-specific color logic:
- **KO bracket**: `palette_index_a: 2`, `palette_index_b: 8` → `getPaletteColor()` in `koBracket.ts`
- **Player progress charts**: hardcoded `PLAYER_COLOR = "#2563eb"` (not palette-driven)
- **Competition breakdown**: `getPaletteColor(idx % 10)` by sort order, not tournament type

To color BM/NBM/SBM series consistently, you'd add a map in `tournamentGroupName.ts` or `color-utils.ts`, e.g.:

```typescript
const TOURNAMENT_GROUP_COLORS: Record<string, number> = {
  "Bayerische Meisterschaft Einzel": 0,      // rainbowPastel[0]
  "Nordbayrische Meisterschaft Einzel": 1,  // rainbowPastel[1]
  "Südbayerische Meisterschaft Einzel": 2,   // rainbowPastel[2]
};
```

## 4. Design system chart constraints

From `c:\Users\cfell\repositories\bowlyzer_deploy\designsystem\design-system.md`:

- **Do not redefine** `rainbowPastel` / `harmonic10` for series colors — owned by `color-utils.ts`.
- Chart series configs from legacy carry over unchanged.
- Semantic chart tokens:
  - `chart.bg` = `surface`
  - `chart.gridline` = `border` @ 0.6 opacity
  - `chart.axis` = `fg-muted`
  - `chart.crosshair` = `accent` @ 0.5
- Numeric labels in charts: **JetBrains Mono** (club chart already uses this for dot labels).
- Sections: no card wrapper around whole blocks; optional `rounded-sm border border-border bg-surface p-3` around chart canvas (see `TrendChart.tsx`).

## 7. Implementation patterns to reuse

### Transform API rows → chart series

```typescript
// Pseudocode mirroring ClubPositionHistoryChart
const grouped = Map<tournament_group, Record<season, position>>();
for (const row of rows) {
  const key = row.tournament_group ?? normalizeTournamentGroupName(row.tournament);
  grouped.get(key) ??= {};
  if (row.position != null) grouped.get(key)![row.season] = row.position;
}
const seriesList = [...grouped].map(([group, history]) => ({
  id: group,
  label: tournamentGroupAbbreviation(group) ?? group,
  color: getPaletteColor(fixedIndexForGroup(group)), // new helper
  history, // simplified: { season → { final_position, league_level: 1, league_name: group } }
}));
```

For a **rank-only** chart, skip `combinedPositionValue()` and plot `final_position` directly on Y with `inverse: true`, `min: 1`, `max: maxRank`, and reuse the inside-circle label pattern from `teamHistoryChart.ts`.

### Styling wrapper (DS-compliant)

```tsx
<div className="rounded-sm border border-border bg-surface p-3">
  <EChart option={option} height={400} />
</div>
```

## Summary gap

The club chart and the tournament **in-event** position chart both exist and share the inverted-Y pattern. What's **missing** is a **cross-season tournament position history chart** on `/turnier?player=` — data is already available via `usePlayerTournamentResults`, but `TournamentPlayerOverview` only renders a `DataTable`. The club chart's `buildPositionHistoryChartOption` + `EChart` wrapper is the closest reusable implementation, with a simpler Y-axis (plain rank, not league-tier encoding) and per-`tournament_group` series colors to be defined for BM/NBM/SBM.
